items.item_text: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the State of California
Basic Life Support (BLS) certification - American Heart Association
One (1) year of experience in care of the aged, acutely ill, chronically ill, and patients in need of restorative care.
One (1) year of experience supervising nursing personnel within SNF/LTC
Utilizes technology, procedures, protocols, standards and interventions specific to assigned unit.
Performs legible, timely, concise and accurate documentation according to policies and procedures. Proficient and competent with the computerized documentation system.

Communicates clearly and effectively using proper communication etiquette. Uses medical terminology accurately. Includes reporting abnormals or change in patient condition to appropriate personnel in a timely manner

When within scope of practice to correct quality concerns do so immediately and report to nursing management team. If not within scope of practice report quality concern immediately to management team for assistance or direction.
Adheres to the policies, procedures and standards in the delivery of the planned resident's care in the preparation and administration of medications and treatments as ordered by the Physician daily.

Demonstrates clinical ability to identify changes and/or abnormal signs and symptoms of the aged, acutely or chronically ill and initiates prompt follow up with Physician, resident and/or responsible party and with appropriate documentation with 95-98% accuracy and timeliness daily in accordance with the Nursing Practice Act.

Skills: Demonstrated ability to communicate proficiently both orally and in writing in the English language Knowledge in the principles of nursing care within the RN, LVN and CNA scope of practice Working knowledge of Title 22, OBRA regulations and Joint Commission requirements
